question.prompt: In parallelogram \(ABCD\), the diagonals satisfy \(AC=BD=10\), and \(AB=6\). Find the length of \(BC\).

solutions.explanation: A parallelogram with equal diagonals is a rectangle, so \(\angle ABC=90^\circ\), and \(BC=\sqrt{10^2-6^2}=8\).
solutions.title: Recognize a rectangle and use the Pythagorean theorem
